_meta.source: Origin: the element-amount sliders that seeded the planet in the old solar-system project (now flicker-solarbirth). Each row = one element's starting RELATIVE abundance weight (renormalised per cell) — its competition strength in the Epoch-1 composition scatter.
_meta.levers_vs_representation: These are the GENERATIVE LEVERS — the crust-forming elements whose amounts drive the crust/differentiation calculations (the tunable sliders). Every OTHER element in periodic_table.json is still represented in the world: Epoch 1 falls any unlisted element to Epoch1Params.abundance_floor (a trace), so the whole table is present everywhere. The gameplay guarantee that matters is separate — every element must form at least ONE harvestable NODE somewhere on the planet (enforced in generation, not by adding a slider per element).
_meta.note: Weights mirror Earth's crustal mass-%. Loaded by flicker-worldengine via GeneratorParamsSource (JSON now, DB later). Abundance is a GENERATION parameter, deliberately NOT a periodic-table column.
